seo.title: Meknes Travel Guide 2026 | Imperial City, Bab Mansour & Volubilis | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Meknes travel guide: El Hedim Square, Bab Mansour, old medina, and the Roman ruins of Volubilis. Plan your trip and places to stay.

name: Meknes
hero_subtitle: The quiet imperial city — massive Bab Mansour gate, historic El Hedim square and Volubilis Roman ruins.

info.area_val: Imperial heritage, massive ramparts and traditional calm

overview.title: Meknes Imperial City — heritage and serenity
overview.p1: Meknes is one of Morocco's major imperial cities, famous for its monumental ramparts and the magnificent Bab Mansour gate. It offers a much more relaxed and intimate atmosphere compared to Fez or Marrakech.
overview.p2: One to two days cover the medina monuments and the main square, with a mandatory side trip to the nearby Roman site of Volubilis.

places.title: Must-visit places in Meknes
places.subtitle: Historic gates, squares, mausoleums and nearby Roman cities.

bab-mansour.title: Bab Mansour
bab-mansour.desc: Morocco's most famous imperial gate decorated with exquisite zellige tiles.

hedim.title: El Hedim Square
hedim.desc: The beating heart of the city, like a more intimate version of Jemaa el-Fna.

medina.title: Meknes Old Medina
medina.desc: Lively lanes and traditional souks away from mass tourism.

moulay-ismail.title: Moulay Ismail Mausoleum
moulay-ismail.desc: Historic sanctuary reflecting the grandeur of Ismaelian architecture.

volubilis.title: Volubilis
volubilis.desc: Morocco's most impressive Roman archaeological site just 30 km away.

dar-jamai.title: Dar Jamai Museum
dar-jamai.desc: 19th-century palace showcasing folk arts and local craftsmanship.

itinerary.title: 2 days in Meknes
itinerary.subtitle: The imperial city first, then Volubilis and Moulay Idriss.

detailed_itinerary.day1_m: Morning — Bab Mansour & El Hedim Square
detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Start by admiring Bab Mansour and wandering around lively El Hedim Square.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Visit Moulay Ismail Mausoleum and explore the historic medina lanes.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Enjoy a traditional Moroccan dinner overlooking the illuminated square.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Morning trip to Volubilis to discover its stunning Roman mosaics.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Short stop in the holy hillside town nearby.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Final mint tea before heading to your next destination.

card2.name: Hotel Ibis Meknes

card3.name: Dar Meknes Charm

booking_banner.title: Explore All Places to Stay in Meknes
booking_banner.desc: Compare real-time rates, read verified guest reviews, and discover more riads and hotels on Booking.com.

eat.title: Where to eat in Meknes
eat.subtitle: Authentic Moroccan cuisine and traditional tagines near major sights.

item1.title: El Hedim Square Restaurants
item1.desc: Local specialties and street grills in a vibrant atmosphere.

item2.title: Medina Guesthouses
item2.desc: Homemade Moroccan tagines served inside Moorish settings.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Petit and grand taxis are readily available. A taxi or private driver is recommended for Volubilis.

bargain.title: Walking tour
bargain.desc: The medina and major monuments are very walkable to fully enjoy the atmosphere.

water.title: Relaxed vibe
water.desc: Meknes is much quieter than Marrakech, making it perfect for a stress-free stroll.

daytrips.title: Day trips from Meknes
daytrips.subtitle: Discover the surrounding treasures of the imperial region.

volubilis.name: Volubilis & Moulay Idriss
volubilis.desc: Morocco's premier Roman site and the neighboring holy town.

fes.name: Fez
fes.desc: Under an hour away by train to explore the spiritual neighbor.

q1.question: How many days in Meknes?
q1.answer: One full day covers the main city highlights, but plan a second day to visit Volubilis.

q2.question: How do I get to Meknes?
q2.answer: Easily accessible via ONCF trains connecting directly from Fez, Rabat, or Casablanca.
